description: This file contains implementation of the voice SDK initialization, plugin loading, version info, and thread handling functions for the xr-voice-sdk, including dynamic loading of various plugins and configuration parsing.

methods.name: vsdk_version
methods.description: Fills version information structure with SDK version details.

methods.name: vsdk_init
methods.description: Initializes the SDK, loads core plugins, and sets up logging.

methods.name: vsdk_init_user_print
methods.description: Initializes SDK with user-defined print functions and loads plugins.

methods.name: vsdk_term
methods.description: Terminates SDK, unloads plugins, and cleans up resources.

methods.name: vsdk_log_level_get
methods.description: Retrieves current log level for a specified module.

methods.name: vsdk_log_level_set
methods.description: Sets log level for a specified module.

methods.name: vsdk_log_level_set_all
methods.description: Sets log level for all modules.

methods.name: vsdk_thread_poll
methods.description: Sets a thread polling function to be called periodically.

methods.name: vsdk_thread_response
methods.description: Invokes the thread polling function if set.

methods.name: vsdk_curtail_xraudio_enabled
methods.description: Returns whether xraudio curtailing is enabled.

methods.name: vsdk_hal_in_enabled
methods.description: Returns whether HAL input is enabled.

methods.name: vsdk_hal_out_enabled
methods.description: Returns whether HAL output is enabled.

methods.name: vsdk_hal_plugin_get
methods.description: Returns the HAL plugin API interface.

methods.name: vsdk_kwd_plugin_get
methods.description: Returns the KWD plugin API interface.

methods.name: vsdk_eos_plugin_get
methods.description: Returns the EOS plugin API interface.

methods.name: vsdk_dga_plugin_get
methods.description: Returns the DGA plugin API interface.

methods.name: vsdk_sdf_plugin_get
methods.description: Returns the SDF plugin API interface.

methods.name: vsdk_ovc_plugin_get
methods.description: Returns the OVC plugin API interface.

methods.name: vsdk_ppr_plugin_get
methods.description: Returns the PPR plugin API interface.

methods.name: vsdk_xraudio_allow_input_failure
methods.description: Returns whether input failure is allowed in xraudio.
